title: Fluid Power Systems and Comonents - Cylinders - Nominal Pressure
clause_1_scope: This standard prescribes selection of nominal pressure for hydraulic and pneumatic fluid power cylinders.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Fluid Power Systems and Components - Vocabulary
Fluid power systems and components - Nominal pressures

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
